DETAILS
Why You'll Love It

Fabric: Lightweight summer-weight woven cotton-blend with a soft hand and easy drape — built for sun-warm days, beach mornings, and unhurried family photos.

Family Story: A four-role matching set in one print — sleeveless dress for mom and the girls, short-sleeve button-down shirt for dad and the boys, plus matching pull-on shorts for dad and the boys for a head-to-toe coordinated look.

Print: Geometric Blue — a deep cobalt ground scattered with small repeating medallion dots, photographing crisp at any distance.

Design: Choose Dress for a sleeveless A-line silhouette in mom and girl sizes; choose Shirt for a relaxed short-sleeve button-down with a soft camp collar; choose Shorts to add matching pull-on shorts for the boys and dad.

Care: Machine wash cold with like colors, gentle cycle. Line dry or tumble dry low. Cool iron inside-out if needed. Do not bleach.

Size Range: Girls & Boys 1–10 Years · Mother S–3XL · Father S–3XL (Shirt & Shorts) — exact measurements below.

Size Chart — Dress (Mom & Girl)
Size Chart — Shirt & Shorts (Dad & Boy)

Geometric Blue is built for the easy summer rhythm of resort mornings, harborside lunches, and cousin-pile family photos. The deep cobalt ground keeps the look grown-up and photo-ready, while the small repeating medallion dot pattern reads crisp from across the room and stays interesting up close. Pick the role each family member needs — a sleeveless dress for mom and the girls, a relaxed short-sleeve button-down for dad and the boys, and matching pull-on shorts for the boys and dad to round out a head-to-toe coordinated look.

Shirts and shorts are sold per piece, so you can mix and match — add an extra shirt for grandpa, skip the shorts and pair the shirt with chinos, or layer dresses for sisters in different sizes. The relaxed cuts move easily on warm days, the pull-on shorts skip fussy closures for the kids, and the whole set photographs as one print run so the family reads coordinated even with different silhouettes.
